project_name: ZAYADO - Creative Link-in-Bio & Personal Hub Platform
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC DISRUPTION (Tactile Dark Glass + Neo-Editorial Typography)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-converting, ultra-sleek, interactive link-in-bio hub inspired by ZAYADO with live preview customization, link analytics, dynamic media embeds, QR code generation, theme builder, and social feed integration.
Ensure pure JS/JSX compatibility ( do NOT use TS types or .tsx extensions ).
Integrate Lucide Icons and optional @phosphor-icons/react for modern visual flair.
Include mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive and key data display elements.
Implement smooth tabs, audio player widget, video preview modal, tip/donation micro-modal, and newsletter subscription form with Sonner toast feedback.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, py-12) with smooth backdrop-blur glassmorphism panels, 1px subtle borders (border-white/10), and neon accent highlights.

typography.heading_font: Outfit / Cabinet Grotesk (sans-serif display with high character and tight tracking)
typography.body_font: Inter / DM Sans (clean legibility for bio text, link labels, and stats)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (used for stats badges, handles, and technical tags)

hierarchy.h1_profile_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white

colors.background: bg-[#090A0F] (Deep Obsidian with subtle radial glow)
colors.surface: bg-zinc-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-all duration-300
colors.primary_accent: #10B981 (Emerald Neon Glow for CTAs and highlighted links)
colors.secondary_accent: #8B5CF6 (Vibrant Electric Violet for secondary actions & feature tags)
colors.contrast_hover_rule: Always explicitly define text color on hover, e.g. hover:bg-emerald-500 hover:text-black focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-400

grids_and_layouts.preview_frame: lg:col-span-5 sticky top-6 max-w-[380px] mx-auto w-full aspect-[9/19] rounded-[40px] border-[6px] border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0D14]

components_structure.name: ProfileHeader
components_structure.features: Avatar with online indicator ring, verified badge, handle (@zayado.official), bio tagline, location tag, and social quick-links row.

components_structure.name: FeaturedLinkCard
components_structure.features: Big banner link card with custom thumbnail, title, subtitle, click counter, animated shimmer border ('Tracing Beam'), and direct action arrow.

components_structure.name: StandardLinksList
components_structure.features: Interactive stack of link items (Store, YouTube Latest Video, Podcast Episode, Booking, Contact Form, Newsletter, Support/Tip jar).

components_structure.name: MediaEmbedWidget
components_structure.features: Embedded playable audio player widget / Spotify style mini-player & video modal trigger.

components_structure.name: TipJarModal
components_structure.features: Shadcn Dialog for micro-donations ($3, $5, $10, custom amount) with quick payment methods and confirmation toast.

components_structure.name: QRCodeModal
components_structure.features: Modal to display & download printable custom QR code with brand logo overlay.

components_structure.name: AppearanceCustomizer
components_structure.features: Theme picker tab (Obsidian Emerald, Cyberpunk Purple, Swiss Clean, Sunset Glow) with real-time preview updating.

components_structure.name: AnalyticsSummary
components_structure.features: Quick analytics dashboard stats (Total Views, Link Clicks, CTR %, Top Location) powered by Shadcn charts / high-density metrics.

motion.hover_effect: transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all duration-200 ease-out
motion.stagger_children: Stagger entrance by 0.05s per link item for organic load feel
motion.reduced_motion: Use prefers-reduced-motion check to disable heavy transform animations

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
